heading: 1. Philosophy
text:
## 1. Philosophy [LUNI.1]

Units are first-class types. The unit system enforces dimensional correctness at
compile time, auto-converts within dimensions, and requires explicit formulas for
cross-dimension relationships. There are no implicit coercions that change physical
meaning.

The standard library (`units.si`) follows the SI International System of Units
(9th edition, 2019) exactly. Where SI makes distinctions that pure dimensional
analysis would collapse, the DS unit system follows SI:

- `frequency` (Hz) and `radioactivity` (Bq) are **separate dimensions** even
  though both are dimensionally `1/s`. Adding a decay rate to a signal frequency
  is a compile error.
- `absorbed_dose` (Gy) and `equivalent_dose` (Sv) are **separate dimensions**
  even though both are dimensionally `J/kg`. The biological weighting context
  is distinct.

This is the same protection the unit system provides everywhere: the compiler
rejects physically meaningless arithmetic even when the dimensional formula
happens to be identical.
